questions.solution: The sine function at π/6 (or 30°) is equal to 1/2 or 0.5.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake: Choosing B (1), which is the value of cos(π/6) instead of sin(π/6).

questions.stem: What is the value of cos(π)?
questions.solution: The cosine function at π is equal to -1.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake: Choosing B (1), which is the value of cos(0).

questions.solution: The tangent function at π/4 (or 45°) is equal to 1.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake: Choosing D (undefined), which is the value of tan(π/2).

questions.solution: The cotangent function at π/3 (or 60°) is equal to 1/√3.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake: Choosing A (√3), which is the value of tan(π/3).

questions.solution: The secant function is undefined at -π/2.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake: Choosing C (-1), which is the value of cos(-π/2).

questions.solution: The cosecant function at 3π is equal to 1.
questions.explanation: csc(3π) = 1 (since sin(3π) = 0, csc is the reciprocal of sin)
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake: Choosing D (undefined), which would be correct for sec(-π/2) but not for csc(3π).

questions.stem: Simplify the expression cos(2x) when x = π/4:
questions.solution: The cosine of twice an angle is equal to 1 - 2sin^2(x). Plugging in x = π/4, we get cos(π/2) = 1 - 2(1/2)^2 = 1 - 1/2 = 1/2 or √2/2.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake: Choosing C (1), which is the value of cos(0) and not for this specific case when x = π/4.
